job.name: D0StandaloneProduction
job.command:
set NEVENTS = 1000 @ PYTHIA_SEED = 1000011 + ${JOBINDEX}
set SCRATCH = `pwd` set PROJECT = /gpfs01/star/pwg/lomicond/Ondrej/Jets/PythiaD0JetGeant/D0EmbeddingClean set OLD_D0WF = /gpfs/mnt/gpfs01/star/pwg/lomicond/Ondrej/Jets/PythiaD0JetGeant/D0EmbeddingClean set BASEJOB = templates/simulation
foreach FILE (`grep -rl "${OLD_D0WF}" scripts src templates`) sed -i "s|${OLD_D0WF}|${SCRATCH}|g" ${FILE} end
cp "${FILELIST}" "${BASEJOB}/mudst.selected.list"
cp scripts/run_standalone_production_v3.csh run_standalone_production_batch.csh sed -i 's|${NEVENTS}evts_simulation_v1|${NEVENTS}evts_simulation_batch|g' run_standalone_production_batch.csh sed -i 's|${NEVENTS}evts_standalone_v1|${NEVENTS}evts_standalone_batch|g' run_standalone_production_batch.csh
set RUNLOG = "${PROJECT}/log/D0Standalone_${NEVENTS}evts_${JOBID}_${JOBINDEX}.log"
tcsh run_standalone_production_batch.csh ${NEVENTS} 1 0 ${PYTHIA_SEED} >&! "${RUNLOG}" set RUN_STATUS = $status
if ( ${RUN_STATUS} != 0 ) then exit ${RUN_STATUS} endif
set PICO = work/jobs/st_physics_15130045_raw_1000011_${NEVENTS}evts_standalone_batch/pico/st_physics_15130045_raw_1000011.picoDst.root set FINALPICO = "${PROJECT}/production/D0Standalone_${NEVENTS}evts_${JOBID}_${JOBINDEX}.picoDst.root"
if ( ! -s "${PICO}" ) then echo "ERROR: final PicoDst is missing: ${PICO}" >> "${RUNLOG}" exit 90 endif
cp "${PICO}" "${FINALPICO}" exit $status
